title: FlexLine Credit Review Tenure Relief
content:
On FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, the tenure relief scales the review cut by the age of the line from its open date: 48 months or more give 0.50; 24 months or more but fewer than 48 give 0.75; a younger line gives 1.00.

The relief multiplies the whole review cut, as finally added up, before the cut is applied to the credit limit. The age is counted in whole calendar months from the open date to the review date, a month counting only once the review date's day of the month reaches the open date's day of the month.

| Age of the line on the review date | Relief |
|---|---|
| 48 whole calendar months or more | 0.50 |
| 24 to 47 whole calendar months | 0.75 |
| fewer than 24 whole calendar months | 1.00 |

*Hypothetical figures:* a review cut of 0.20 on a line 30 months old becomes 0.15; on a line 50 months old it becomes 0.10; on a line 20 months old it stays 0.20.
